method.mrd: Embedded PPR text is parsed from the MRD (October 5 parser); dimensions and datatype from the binary header.
method.comparison: Protocol fields are compared after trimming acquisition arrays to each side's no_diff_acq and dropping acq_grad (inactive in b-input mode 1). Runtime-only AcquisitionStartTime, PerformanceCounterFrequency and END are excluded. Scanner records (gains, masks, delays) are reported separately.
method.references: adjacent = PPR in the scan folder; planned_console_fixed = experiments/2026-10-11_exvivo_plan_console_fixed; planned_original = experiments/2026-10-11_exvivo_plan; TT and UU use the T and U plans; v1.911-0 uses the 2026-10-10 scan I MRD because it is unplanned.
method.counter: Hardware performance counter (10 MHz), relative chronology only; not a calendar timestamp.
method.source_identity: PPL paths are version labels only; the MRD carries no source-content hash.
